test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some vehicles are helicopters.

All helicopters are cars.

**Conclusions:**

I. All vehicles are cars.

II. Some vehicles are cars.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
Statements:

Some vehicles are helicopters.

All helicopters are cars.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df85407cb146069608bc136835219f5607636557e71e61f4ce41e9d6780a0ac8.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All vehicles are cars - False (Because, Some vehicles are cars, so All vehicles are cars is possible only).

II. Some vehicles are cars - True (Because, Some vehicles are helicopters and All helicopters are Cars so Some Vehicles are Cars is true).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
